title: CCIX link layer over PCIe: protocol messages (Request, Snoop, Response) packed into PCIe vendor-defined message TLPs, Request and Snoop credits, credit return by piggyback or Misc message

fields.desc: this end's PCIe ID: the Requester ID of TLPs sent, the target ID TLPs received must carry
the peer's PCIe ID: the target ID of TLPs sent

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Message word to send: a header {MsgType, MsgLen, credit fields (replaced), 16 protocol bits}, then MsgLen - 1 body words. A Request or Snoop header is taken once a credit is held

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received message word; reading it pops it. A Request or Snoop's credit goes back to the peer once its last word is read

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a malformed TLP or message was dropped, a bad header was written to TX, or a credit grant would pass 31

irqs.name: NOCRD
irqs.desc: a Request or Snoop came without a credit and was skipped

irqs.name: OVF
irqs.desc: a Response found no room in the receive buffer and was skipped

notes: tlp_tx_* and tlp_rx_* are the TLP streams to and from the PCIe transaction layer; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters MAXP (16), NREQ (2), NSNP (2), RXD (64) and CRT (16) keep their defaults.
